products.productName: Set of 2 4ft Pre Lit Potted Porch Trees

description.formatted:
* Set of 2 matching trees
* Alpine style design
* Pre-lit LED lights
* Warm ambient glow

Add a welcoming festive touch to your entrance with this set of two 4ft pre-lit porch trees. The alpine-inspired design brings a natural look, ideal for placing either side of your front door. Each tree comes pre-lit with warm LED lights, creating a soft glow as guests arrive. The flexible branches can be shaped to suit your space and packed away neatly after use. Set in pots and battery operated, they’re easy to position without needing a nearby socket. A great option for creating a balanced, seasonal display outdoors or in sheltered areas.

* Personalise this bauble with a name up to 12 characters long.
* The personalisation will appear as entered. Please avoid using fixed upper case as this may make the personalisation hard to read.

This Personalised Pet Glass Bauble is a great way to add a personal touch to the Christmas tree. Inside the glass bauble is a paw print printed onto an acetate insert which can be personalised with the name of your pet.**How to personalise your product:**

1. Place your order
2. You will receive an email from dunelm@personalisedmemento.co.uk within 1 hour to add your personalised message. If not received, please check your junk folder.
3. Once received, follow the link within the email.
4. Type your message into the fields on screen and click on the preview button to review the personalisation.
5. Once checked and happy, click submit.
6. Production of the order will commence.

**Please note:**

* The content on a personalised product will be produced exactly as you enter it, including spelling and capitalisation. Please ensure that all details, especially the personalised text, are correct before clicking submit.
* Accents, special characters and emojis are not accepted.
* Once the personalisation has been submitted, the order cannot be amended or cancelled.
* If the personalisation is not submitted within 3 days, the order will be automatically cancelled.
* We do not permit personalisation that infringes copyright laws, is indecent or offensive, or contains language deemed to be abusive, threatening, or defamatory. Full content rules can be viewed on the personalisation terms and conditions page. Orders that do not follow these rules will be refused.

By ordering a personalised product, you are agreeing that your details (name and contact details, including address) and the details that you provide of any other party, such as the recipient of the personalised product, can be shared with our third party supplier who provides the personalisation service only for the purposes of completing the personalisation service and delivering the product to you or the recipient.

description.formatted:
* Choice of coloured micro LEDs
* 8 light sequences with memory function
* 6-hour timer function
* 5m clear mains cable
* 5.5m lit length

Give your doorway a bright festive finish with this LED Cluster Lights Door Garland. The 5.5m lit length is ideal for framing a standard-sized front door, with a choice of cool white, warm white or multicoloured micro LEDs. Choose from 8 light sequences, with a handy memory function that remembers your last setting. Suitable for indoor and outdoor displays, the timer provides 6 hours of light before switching off for 18 hours, while the UK mains plug is designed for indoor sockets only.

products.productName: 6ft Pre-Lit Frosted Mixed Berry Artificial Garland

description.formatted:
* Frosted mixed foliage design.
* Red and white berry detailing.
* Warm white LED lights.
* 8 functions with handy timer.

Bring a touch of winter magic to your festive decor with the 6ft Pre-Lit Frosted Mixed Berry Artificial Garland. Beautifully arranged with lush artificial foliage, a snowy flocked finish and clusters of red and white berries, this garland creates a wonderfully wintry look across mantelpieces, staircases or shelving. Warm white LEDs are nestled throughout the foliage for a cosy seasonal glow, with 8 lighting functions allowing you to switch up the ambience. Battery operated for flexible placement around your home, the handy timer keeps the lights on for 6 hours before switching off for 18 hours. Requires 6 x AA batteries, not included.
